letter.subject: Application for Engineer / Technical Officer, Road Design (East), VPS 3
paragraphs: I'm applying for the Engineer / Technical Officer, Road Design (East) position advertised on Careers Vic. Road layouts, intersections, drainage and roadside safety, designed under supervision to Austroads and DTP guidelines, is the work my Australian diploma trained me in, and I want to build a road design career in the Victorian public service. Here is how my experience meets each selection criterion.

Foundational engineering knowledge, applied professionally: my Bachelor of Science in Civil Engineering (Philippines, 2019) is the mandatory civil qualification, and in February 2026 I completed an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design at the Albright Institute of Business and Language. There I designed and documented road geometry, earthworks, pavement and stormwater drainage in AutoCAD and Civil 3D to Australian Standards and Austroads guides, applied AS 1742.14, AS 1726 and AS 1289, kept risk registers, and lodged Before You Dig Australia enquiries so designs fitted around existing services.

Adaptable and technically capable: my CAD work is AutoCAD and Civil 3D, and I have not used MicroStation or OpenRoads yet; I learnt Civil 3D and Revit from scratch during the diploma and would take the same approach to the Bentley tools. Delivering work and keeping records: on site in the Philippines from April 2019 to February 2020 I planned each day's priorities for 10 to 15 workers, tracked procurement and materials, and kept site reports, material records and progress reports.

Working collaboratively and applying sound judgement: on those sites I coordinated with engineers, subcontractors, suppliers and clients, checked work against the drawings and project requirements, and escalated issues that needed clarification or corrective action rather than guessing. I hold a White Card, an Australian driver's licence with my own transport, and full working rights until December 2027 on a Subclass 485 visa; I'm based in Melton and can travel within Victoria for site inspections.

My resume is attached and my drawings, including a two-lane road cross-section with kerbs and drainage, are at https://macdarenz-droid.github.io/Portfolio. I'd welcome a conversation about the team's projects.

Attach the two PDFs from this record (resume and cover letter). The cover letter already addresses each key selection criterion; if the portal asks for criterion responses separately, paste the screening answers above.
Submit before 11:59 pm Tuesday 6 October 2026. Email and manual submissions are not accepted.

Press Applied on the tracker with the date and "Company website". Only after that, the short prepared email to Vincent Nguyen (the further-information contact printed on the advert) may be sent, with the date filled in.
